story.body: You kept the morning to what is set down. Garnish wrote no total. Kemp asked for remuneration and was given the word, not a new line. You told Nick the gown is not a performance while fifty shillings is unpaid. You left the refusal as you marked it yesterday.

story.body: You kept Nick in his own doublet. The boys changed the favours and sent the mockery back. Pope stayed at his post. Garnish wrote no total. You sent Burbage's rhyme out to the yard.
